messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 12 free, locally running voice tools.
- Add Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) support throughout the tools, including voice selection, text input, speech recognition, dubbing, and keyboard assistance.

## Requirements
- Mobile-first design with rounded white cards, green accent `#309D4B`, and horizontally scrollable mobile navigation.
- Use built-in browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`. No sign-up or paid APIs.
- Reload voices on `voiceschanged`; provide friendly API errors and note voices depend on the browser and device.
- Voice Cloning links to `https://play.cartesia.ai`.
- Preserve existing local audio processing and clarify its limitations: Text to MP3 records microphone audio while speech synthesis plays through speakers; Speech to Text requires on-device recognition; Voice Changer and Voice Conversion are local approximations, not AI conversion.
- Add `Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) - kn-IN` as the first option in every language dropdown; filter voices by language starting with `kn` and select a `kn-IN` voice when Kannada is chosen.
- If no Kannada voice is found, show: `Kannada voice not installed. On Android: Settings > Language > Text-to-speech > Google > Install voice data > Kannada. On Windows: Settings > Time & Language > Speech > Add voices > Kannada.`
- Set the Text to Speech and AI Voice Generator textareas to `lang="kn"` and use Noto Sans Kannada; add the four specified Kannada sample chips.
- Add Kannada speech recognition (`recognition.lang = "kn-IN"`), a Kannada typing/mic option, and a Copy button.
- Allow Kannada voice selection per AI Voiceover scene; add an English → Kannada dubbing option for pasted translated text.
- Support Kannada text and downloads in Text to MP3.
- Add a Kannada Keyboard helper with the specified common-letter buttons and an insertion target, plus the hint: `Type in English letters, then use Google Input Tools (free) to convert.`
- Keep the page UI in English and Kannada; tools remain free and use Web Speech API.

## Decisions
- Text to MP3 captures speech through the microphone because browsers do not expose speechSynthesis audio directly; warn that headphones may not be captured.
- Speech-to-Text requires on-device recognition support.
- Voice Changer and Voice Conversion use local pitch/filter approximations and clarify that real AI conversion requires a model.
- Voice Cloning is linked to Cartesia Playground and does not clone locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing `index.html` implements the 12-tool VoiceStudio site, navigation, inline CSS/JS, voice loading, speech synthesis, audio processing/recording, and required disclaimers.
- Wired Realistic Text to Speech speed and pitch controls; fixed AI Voice Enhancer Before/After playback.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and verified syntax with `node --check`.
- Previous request to return the complete file remains unfinished; prior response was truncated and only a partial continuation was provided.

### Active
- Implement Kannada support throughout `index.html`, including language selectors, Kannada voice detection and guidance, textareas and sample chips, recognition, voiceover, dubbing, MP3, keyboard helper, and transliteration hint.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` to implement the Kannada requirements across all applicable tools.
2. Run JavaScript syntax validation and verify the language/voice selection behavior.
3. Return the completed file as requested, without explanations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation to update.

- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked. Other untracked files include `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- No Kannada changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 12 free, locally running voice tools and Kannada support throughout.
- Finish the Kannada implementation in `index.html`, verify it, and fulfill the pending request to return the complete file.

## Requirements
- Keep the mobile-first design, rounded white cards, green `#309D4B` accent, and horizontally scrollable navigation.
- Use built-in browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`; no sign-up or paid APIs.
- Reload voices on `voiceschanged`; provide friendly API errors and note voices depend on the browser and device.
- Voice Cloning links to `https://play.cartesia.ai`; preserve existing local audio processing and its limitations.
- Add `Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) - kn-IN` first in every language dropdown; filter Kannada voices by `lang` starting with `kn` and select a `kn-IN` voice when available.
- If no Kannada voice is found, show: `Kannada voice not installed. On Android: Settings > Language > Text-to-speech > Google > Install voice data > Kannada. On Windows: Settings > Time & Language > Speech > Add voices > Kannada.`
- Set AI Voice Generator and Text to Speech textareas to `lang="kn"` and Noto Sans Kannada; include the four specified Kannada sample chips.
- Support Kannada speech recognition (`kn-IN`), typing/keyboard assistance, transcript copying, per-scene voice selection, English → Kannada dubbing of pasted translations, and Kannada Text to MP3 downloads.
- Keep the UI in English and Kannada; tools remain free and use Web Speech API.

## Decisions
- Text to MP3 captures speech through the microphone because browsers do not expose `speechSynthesis` audio directly; warn that headphones may not be captured.
- Speech-to-Text requires on-device recognition support.
- Voice Changer and Voice Conversion are local pitch/filter approximations, not AI conversion.
- Voice Cloning links to Cartesia Playground and does not clone locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing 12-tool VoiceStudio site and its local audio processing, navigation, and disclaimers are in `index.html`.
- Added Kannada font styling, Kannada textareas and sample chips, a Kannada keyboard helper with an insertion textarea and transliteration hint, and a typed-text-to-transcript action.
- Added Kannada-first language options, Kannada voice filtering/selection and missing-voice guidance, per-scene language/voice selectors, a dubbing language shortcut, and Kannada MP3/recognition language handling.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and passed `node --check` before the latest small dubbing/voiceover edits.

### Active
- Re-run JavaScript syntax validation after the latest edits and review Kannada selection/warning behavior.
- Return the completed `index.html` in response to the pending full-file request.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Extract the inline script from `index.html` and run `node --check` after the latest edits.
2. Review dropdown population, missing-voice guidance, and scene/dubbing Kannada selection for regressions.
3. Return the complete file as requested.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation; untracked and contains the current changes.

- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked. Other untracked files include `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
